variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. The event places representation at the centre of public attention. The assessment of {target} should distinguish the holding of an election from any claim about what its result authorises.

For owners and managers, an election is an institutional event before it is a forecast. A sound commercial judgment should not infer a tax measure, a spending plan or a business climate merely from the fact that voting has taken place. Decisions need their own evidence.

This paper reserves judgment on {target}. Holding an election establishes that a contest occurred; it does not settle every question about the conduct or merits of those involved. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.

variants.headline: Ballots before the business of government
variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
